description: Searches the Softwear Prints catalogue of textiles and promotional items that can be printed or embroidered. Supports free text and filters for category, brand, colour, size, target group, material, certification and price. Returns name, brand, article number, unit price (net and gross), colours and a link to the product page.

category.description: Category slug or id as returned by list_categories.

color.description: Colour names in German or English, e.g. ['navy'] or ['rot'].

language.description: Language of product names in the result.

page_size.description: Products per page. With a colour filter a page can hold more or fewer products.

price_basis.description: Whether price_min and price_max include German VAT (gross) or not (net).

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'polo shirt organic cotton'.

name: search_products
title: Search products
